result.brief: 提出首个行为世界模型 InterTrack，用 Transformer 联合预测动作、状态与行为分布，学习环境条件动力学，实现人形机器人跨地形全身跟踪与交互。
result.reason: Behavior world model predicting next action, state, and behavior distribution for environment-conditioned dynamics; embodied world model with planning-relevant dynamics, matching world_model direction.
